Unlike a pause the fence does not expire, so nothing is on a clock — but 'permanent' describes the fence, not the incident. The underlying fault on eb798430-c3ad-5a44-b7d7-d15ab54d3f76 is unchanged and still needs a human decision on the real fix. Treat the stabilization as a clock, not an outcome.
